keyFindings.description: isListMode (:39-44) exempts any argv carrying `--list` from both refusals, the DISPATCH_E2E_REUSE_SERVERS one (:69) included. Playwright reads `--grep --list` or `--grep-invert --list` as a grep value and runs specs. With harness ports in the shell and no reuse flag, such a run targets those servers, and seed.ts truncates their database, which is what :69 refuses. On main the same argv met Playwright's own refusal, because webServer would not reuse a taken port. The comment at :37-38 and packages/dispatch/AGENTS.md:1102-1104 claim no spec runs. Fix: a listing exempts only the unset-ports refusal; the reuse refusal stands whenever a targeted port is set.
